name: src-fragger
description: src-fragger — every piece of code the agent writes to complete a task (a sweep script, a migration, a one-off probe, a generator: anything that replaces manual, user-involved labor) is a frag, and a frag is written to the VLDS store's src/ directory, never to the session scratchpad or a temp dir. The scratchpad dies with the session; a frag outlives it, so the next task that needs the same labor updates the frag instead of rewriting it, the user can read and edit it (an edit is a ruling), and when the harness refuses the agent's own execution the frag is already where the user can run it. A SessionStart hook injects the contract; a PreToolUse hook asks before a code file is written to a temp location; the store's src/frags.md is the register. Standalone; pairs with vlds by sharing its store.
